coverage.method: Signed-in Chrome browser: scrolled the Posts timeline to its loaded bottom, collected rendered post text, expansion controls, original publication times and video/GIF labels; opened qualifying candidates to read their own full text.
coverage.scope: 241 distinct profile entries reviewed, reaching an April 11, 2014 post. 60 expressions qualify: 54 expandable text posts and 6 original captioned videos. This is the loaded Posts timeline, not an account export.
gaps: X can omit entries from its loaded timeline; reaching the bottom is not proof of an exhaustive archive.
Replies and repost archives were not traversed. No connected expandable thread was identified for consolidation.
Five native X Articles were observed but are outside the current strict expandable-post/video selection. Their full article bodies were not inspected. Include only after the user broadens the rule.
Video captions and players were verified; footage and speech were not reviewed or used to invent descriptions.
Publication dates use rendered time datetime values converted to America/Los_Angeles, matching this signed-in browser. Existing two dates remain unchanged.
coverage.exclusionSummary: 181 observed entries omitted: 171 other short/text-image/repost entries without qualifying expanded own text or original captioned video, 2 short wrappers around included videos, 1 textless video, 1 GIF, 5 native Articles, and 1 bare quote of an Article.
